summary: Enhance your skills in climate change adaptation with our training designed for rural communities. Learn strategies to build resilience and sustainability.
lede: Climate change adaptation for rural communities focuses on assessing climate risks and planning locally appropriate responses. For development professionals involved in rural adaptation, it covers vulnerability analysis, participatory planning, and selecting and budgeting interventions such as climate-smart agriculture, water security, and livelihood diversification, plus monitoring resilience outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who are directly involved in planning, funding, implementing, and evaluating adaptation interventions in rural settings. It is ideal for those seeking practical skills to enhance community resilience and protect livelihoods.
audience: Climate adaptation and resilience officers in development
modules: Ecosystem-Based Adaptation and Natural Resource Management
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning for Adaptation Results
Risk Communication, Behavior Change, and Adoption
Capstone Practical Lab: Community Adaptation Action Plan
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of rural development and community engagement principles. Prior experience in project management or a related field is beneficial.
